How soon should wedding thank-you cards be sent?
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.p: US and Australian etiquette guidance targets four to six weeks after the wedding; three months is the outer limit most guests notice. A short, timely note always reads better than a long, late one.
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.s: What do I write for a cash gift?
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.p: Thank the generosity without naming the amount, then say what it is going toward — the honeymoon, a first home, or savings. A specific purpose turns a polite line into a warm one.
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.s: Do I have to send a note to someone who did not give a gift?
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.p: Yes if they attended. Focus entirely on their presence and a shared memory from the day, and never mention that no gift was received.
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.s: Can I send thank-you notes by email or message?
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.p: Yes. Zola and other ranked guides say digital notes are now widely accepted, especially for close friends. Handwritten cards still carry more weight for older relatives and formal families.
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.s: How do I stop 140 notes sounding identical?
tools.wedding-thank-you-note-generator.p: Use batch mode: one guest per line with their own gift and purpose, and each note is written from its own inputs. Vary the tone between warm, formal, short and playful for different groups.
